name: QR_Rule_10: Office Application Spawning Shell or Script Host
description: Detects Microsoft Office applications spawning command shells, PowerShell, script hosts, or mshta, which can indicate malicious macro execution.
gpo_policy: Office macros must be restricted, Protected View enabled, and unauthorized Windows Script Host or command-shell execution blocked.
expression: SELECT "Image", "ParentImage", "CommandLine", "Computer" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('1','4688') AND ((("ParentImage" ILIKE '%winword.exe' OR "ParentImage" ILIKE '%excel.exe' OR "ParentImage" ILIKE '%outlook.exe' OR "ParentImage" ILIKE '%powerpnt.exe') AND ("Image" ILIKE '%cmd.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%powershell.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%pwsh.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%wscript.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%cscript.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%mshta.exe')) OR "Image" ILIKE '%wscript.exe' OR "Image" ILIKE '%cscript.exe') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: Sysmon or Security process-creation event shows an Office parent spawning a shell or script interpreter, or execution of wscript/cscript. Response: Dispatch New Event and create an Offense indexed by Computer.
